description.en: Restarts play from a given team slot's kickoff/restart position, optionally offsetting it by a 3-element [x, ?, z]-style array.
Index of the team/side to restart play from.
Optional; only read together with offset when at least 3 arguments are given.
Optional 3-element position-offset array, only read when at least 3 arguments are given.
True once the restart has been set up; null if no arguments were given.

example.code:
// Restart play from team 1's side after a scripted sequence
CMND_BTL_SET_MATCH_RESTART(1);
